This site hosts the API reference generated from the Fly.io Machines API OpenAPI
specification. For how to get started, deeper explanations of each endpoint, and
examples, visit the complete [Machines API docs](https://docs.fly.io/machines/api/).Download the [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/openapi.json) to generate a client or explore the API in another tool.

## [​](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines\#base-url)  Base URL

All requests are made against:

```
https://api.machines.dev
```

## [​](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines\#authentication)  Authentication

Authenticate every request with a Fly.io access token using the
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Generate one with
[`fly tokens create`](https://docs.fly.io/flyctl/cmd/fly_tokens_create) or the
[Tokens](https://fly.io/tokens) page on the dashboard.

```
curl https://api.machines.dev/v1/apps?org_slug=personal \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLY_API_TOKEN"
```
